basic_info.description: This meticulously restored two bedroom, one & half bath 1895 Victorian flat beautifully blends historical charm with modern amenities. The new woodwork throughout has been painstakingly matched to the original details, preserving the flat's vintage elegance. It features working fireplaces in both the living room and master bedroom, adding to its classic appeal.    The chef's kitchen is a standout with Carrara marble counters and an island, a Bertazzoni gas range and electric oven, and a Sub Zero refrigerator. The large formal dining room is perfect for hosting gatherings, while custom bookshelves and storage in the living room and bonus/media room offer practicality and style.    The garage offers flexibility: it can remain a one-car garage with a large storage area or be converted back to a deeded two-car garage. Additionally, newer double-paned glass windows in the living room reduce street noise, and newer Anderson French doors open to a recently remodeled back terrace, seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor living spaces.
